listeningBlock.audioScript:
SCENE 1 (monologue):
Hello! I am Zara. Z - A - R - A. I am 26 years old,
and I am from Faro. I am a teacher - I work at a
small school next to the park. Every day I go to
work by bus, at seven thirty.
SCENE 2 (dialogue, in a cafe):
Man:   Good morning! Can I have a coffee and bread,
please? How much is it?
Woman: Three dollars. ... Oh, look - it is raining
again!
Man:   Yes, big rain! And my son is sick at home -
he has a headache. I need his medicine. The
pharmacy is next to the bank, yes?
Woman: Yes, very near. Get well to him! Here - your
coffee and bread.

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - School notice
ENGLISH SCHOOL - NEW STUDENTS WELCOME!
Classes: Monday to Friday, at nine in the morning
OR at seven at night.
One month: forty dollars.
We are on Green Street, next to the supermarket.
From the station: go straight, and turn left at
the bank.
Questions? Write to: hello@school.com

TEXT B - Personal letter
Hi, Bruno!
Greetings from my new life in Porto! I am a student
here. I study in the morning, and at night I work
at a cafe. I can speak Portuguese AND English at
work - good practice!
It is autumn now: wind and rain every day. Today I
am wearing my new black jacket.
My cat, Tuca, sleeps all day. She doesn't like the
rain!
Do you have news? Write to me!
- Alma

writingTask.writingPrompt: Write about YOUR LIFE for a person who does not know you. 10 sentences minimum. Must include: 1. Name, age, city (T1-2) 2. One family member or friend + description (T3-4) 3. Your home (there is/are) (T6) 4. Your day: 2 routine verbs + one time expression (T7-8) 5. Job or study + one can sentence (T14) 6. One hobby + one don't/doesn't sentence (T16) 7. The weather right now, with -ing (T17)
minimumRequirements: 10 sentences minimum, all 7 content points present

speakingTask.speakingPrompt: Run live with the teacher (in person / call) or recorded under supervision: PART 1 - INTERVIEW (teacher asks, student answers in full sentences): 1. What is your name? Can you spell your first name? 2. Where are you from, and how old are you? 3. Tell me about your family. 4. What do you do every day? 5. What is the weather like today? 6. Do you like music? What is your hobby? PART 2 - MONOLOGUE (student speaks 60 seconds; teacher picks ONE): A) Your home and your city B) A person you love C) Your perfect Saturday
